ood._score_note: MaxLogit (Hendrycks 2019) is theoretically robust under temperature scaling and label smoothing where MSP collapses. It is disabled on the shipped artefact (max_logit_floor=null) because the calibration showed NEGATIVE separation: the not_a_plant negatives (COCO / OpenImages / iNat-Animalia) are cleaner and easier than the noisy real-world disease classes, so NAP MaxLogit medians land ABOVE plant medians and any floor that spares real plants catches zero NAPs. With the gate disabled, _should_route_to_nap degrades to a detector-confidence-only gate and OOD rejection rests on the classifier's own not_a_plant head. Regenerate this block from the v2.2 calibration run (compute plant AND NAP MaxLogit from the SAME held-out split, and rebuild NAP with hard negatives) before enabling a floor.
